scope: Corollary 8.12 (Maximal DEC energy inequality) of the manuscript “The spacetime Penrose inequality and enclosing area” (preprints/The-spacetime-Penrose-inequality-and-enclosing-area-September-27-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 260 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 9bb0c350914915db), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 97. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let (X4, gX, KX) be smooth and connected, with X orientable, gX complete as a metric space with its nonempty compact smooth boundary SX included, and with exactly one end, which is asymptotically flat and diffeomorphic to the complement of a closed ball in R4. Let KX be a smooth symmetric covariant two-tensor. Suppose trgX KX = 0, µX = 1 2(RgX − |KX|2 gX ) ≥ | divgX KX|gX , µX, | divgX KX|gX ∈ L1 (X, dVgX ). Assume for some q > 1 that gX − δ = O2(r−q ), KX = O1(r−1−q ), and that the ADM energy EX in (8.1) is finite. On every component of SX, require H +trSX KX ≤ 0 with the normal into X. For the one-ended enclosing-cut infimum of Definition 8.1, denoted here by agX (SX), one has EX ≥ 1 2 (︃ agX (SX) 2π2 )︃2/3 . The boundary may have any topology and finitely many components. No symmetry, vacuum, spin, outermostness, outer area-minimization or momentum-flux assumption is imposed.
